Full job description
Senior MuleSoft Platform Administrator / Engineer

Location: 100% Remote (U.S. Based)

Salary: $120,000 – $140,000 (Based on ExperienceTechnical Interview)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Citizenship: U.S. Citizen Required

Position Overview

Fathom Management is seeking an experienced Senior MuleSoft Platform Administrator / Engineer to support a major Department of Veterans Affairs enterprise integration initiative.

This role is ideal for a senior MuleSoft professional with hands-on experience administering, supporting, or engineering the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform within enterprise environments. The selected candidate will help ensure the stability, scalability, security, and operational excellence of a mission-critical integration platform supporting cloud, hybrid, and on-premises systems.

Working closely with architects, developers, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders, you'll play a key role in API governance, platform administration, production operations, automation, and enterprise integration strategy.

Candidate Verification Notice

For your protection and ours, Fathom Management conducts a brief candidate verification at the beginning of the screening process. Because we support State and Federal Government clients, this verification helps protect your identity, résumé, and application from unauthorized use and confirms that we are speaking directly with the individual who applied for the position.

You may be asked to provide a photo of a government-issued identification document as part of this verification. Video verification may also be required.

Identification is used solely for candidate verification and will be handled in accordance with Fathom Management's privacy and security practices.
